evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact - products saw elevated errors in us-central1 beginning 12 Sep 2023 23:46 Pacific. notes: Published date is the full Incident Report of 19 Sep 2023 16:04 PDT; a Mini Incident Report came 13 Sep 2023. Services: Compute Engine, Persistent Disk, GKE, Bigtable, Dataflow, App Engine, Cloud SQL. Times converted from PDT (UTC-7).

evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact - all Montreal Interconnect customers lost physical connectivity from 14 Aug 2023 16:11 Pacific. End: Remediation and Prevention - second edge domain yul-zone2-1944 came back 15 Aug 2023 11:22 Pacific, closing the 19 hour 11 minute outage. Regions: Root Cause - Montreal interconnects to northamerica-northeast1 failed; the region itself was otherwise unaffected.
notes: Published date is the full Incident Report of 17 Aug 2023; Mini Incident Report was 15 Aug 2023. Affected units are Interconnect Edge Availability Domains yul-zone1-1944 and yul-zone2-1944, not compute zones, so zones is empty; both domains failed, so coded regional. yul-zone1-1944 was restored earlier, 15 Aug 2023 01:06 Pacific (08:06Z), letting customers with redundant links reconnect. Full redundancy returned 16 Aug 2023 14:55 Pacific, after impact ended, so excluded. Service: Cloud Interconnect. Times converted from PDT (UTC-7).
